name: MINIKrea2 RTX-EZ Onstart V3
desc: Private ComfyUI RTX-EZ template using a self-contained onstart bootstrap.
readme:
# MINIKrea2 RTX-EZ Onstart V3

This template uses the fixed self-contained onstart bootstrap published on August 29, 2026.

It avoids the broken `PROVISIONING_SCRIPT` path and uses `onstart.sh`, which the current Vast image actually executes.

It now starts the Vast-style status portal first, then runs the long bootstrap in the background.

It is designed for MiniMax H3 RTX-EZ setup on `vastai/comfy:v0.30.0-cuda-13.2-py312`.
env: -p 1111:1111 -p 8080:8080 -p 8384:8384 -p 72299:72299 -p 8188:18188 -p 8288:8288 -p 10100:10100 -p 10200:10200 -e COMFYUI_ARGS="--disable-auto-launch --disable-xformers --port 18188 --enable-cors-header" -e COMFYUI_API_BASE="http://localhost:18188" -e OPEN_BUTTON_PORT="1111" -e PORTAL_CONFIG="localhost:1111:1111:/:Instance Portal|localhost:8188:18188:/:ComfyUI|localhost:8288:8288:/docs:API Wrapper|localhost:8080:8080:/tree:Jupyter|localhost:8080:8080:/terminals/1:Jupyter Terminal|localhost:8384:8384:/:Syncthing" -e JUPYTER_DIR="/" -e DATA_DIRECTORY="/workspace/" -e WORKSPACE="/workspace" -e HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE="1" -e CIVITAI_BASE_URL="https://civitai.red"
onstart: if [ ! -e /workspace ] && [ -d /opt/workspace-internal ]; then ln -sfn /opt/workspace-internal /workspace; fi; mkdir -p /workspace/minikrea2-tool/vast /workspace/minikrea2-tool/runtime/logs /workspace/minikrea2-tool/runtime/state; curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ahmarii/vast-bootstrap/main/vast/rtxez_onstart_entrypoint.sh -o /workspace/minikrea2-tool/vast/rtxez_onstart_entrypoint.sh; chmod +x /workspace/minikrea2-tool/vast/rtxez_onstart_entrypoint.sh; bash /workspace/minikrea2-tool/vast/rtxez_onstart_entrypoint.sh
